# Kolwen

> Kolwen is a verifiable AI assistant. It is in development and not yet available: nothing can be bought, and the pages marked draft are not in force.

The site is in English and Thai.

## Pages

- [Home](https://kolwen.com/): what Kolwen is and its status
- [Pricing](https://kolwen.com/pricing): the planned plans and their US prices; nothing can be bought yet
- [Terms](https://kolwen.com/terms): the draft terms; not in force, and parts wait for legal review
- [Privacy](https://kolwen.com/privacy): the draft privacy notice; parts wait for legal review
- [Refunds](https://kolwen.com/refund): the draft refund terms; parts wait for legal review
